movie.title: Mata
movie.overview: Wounded while on a clandestine operation in Niger, French secret agent Mata loses track of her colleague Antoine, captured on the spot. Upon her return, she volunteers for a counter-espionage mission in the Alps, with the intuition that this new assignment might somehow be connected to her traumatic mission in Africa. Haunted by Antoine’s captivity and convinced that her managers are hiding information from her, Mata embarks on a race against time, outside any official framework... at the risk of losing everything.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Haunted by a failed secret mission in Niger, French secret agent Mata goes rogue during an Alpine counter-espionage operation to rescue her captured colleague and uncover the truth her superiors are hiding.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: After a clandestine operation in Niger goes disastrously wrong, French secret agent Mata is left wounded and her colleague Antoine is captured. Returning to duty, she volunteers for a counter-espionage mission in the Alps, suspecting a hidden connection to the African operation. Convinced her handlers are keeping key details secret, Mata breaks protocol to pursue her own covert investigation. Operating outside official channels, she embarks on a high-stakes race against time that threatens her career, safety, and life.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: French secret agent Mata suffers a traumatic blow during a covert operation in Niger when her colleague, Antoine, is captured by enemy forces while she barely escapes injured. Back home, Mata is consumed by guilt and plagued by memories of the mission, unable to accept that Antoine has been left behind. When a new counter-espionage assignment arises in the Alps, she immediately steps forward to take it, trusting a deep intuition that this target is secretly linked to the disaster in Africa. As she delves into the Alpine operation, she notices glaring inconsistencies in official intelligence reports and suspects her managers are actively concealing critical information. Realizing her superiors will not support a rescue or reveal the truth, Mata makes the dangerous decision to go rogue. She cuts ties with official protocol, leveraging her elite training to conduct an unsanctioned, off-the-books investigation. Navigating treacherous snowy terrain and shifting intelligence networks, she races against time to untangle a complex web of betrayal before her superiors catch on. With every step away from official oversight, Mata risks alienating her allies and losing her own freedom, but she refuses to stop until she uncovers the full scope of the conspiracy and finds out what really happened to Antoine.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Following a brutal covert operation in Niger that leaves her wounded and her partner Antoine taken captive, French secret agent Mata is thrust into physical and emotional recovery. Back at agency headquarters, her lingering trauma is compounded by a growing suspicion that her superiors are withholding vital details about the operation's failure and Antoine's current status. Seeking answers, Mata volunteers for an Alpine counter-espionage mission, driven by a strong instinct that this local threat shares an unseen connection to the events in Africa. When official channels prove uncooperative and tightly monitored, Mata abandons protocol entirely. Operating off-grid, she launches a dangerous personal investigation into her own agency's secrets, risking everything—her career, her safety, and her life—to uncover the truth and find her missing colleague before time runs out.

story_structure.resolution: Operating beyond the safety of her agency, Mata faces the ultimate consequences of her off-the-grid pursuit, forever altering her path as an operative.
story_structure.introduction: French secret agent Mata suffers a traumatic wound during a clandestine operation in Niger, resulting in the capture of her colleague Antoine by hostile forces.
story_structure.risingAction: Volunteering for a counter-espionage assignment in the Alps, Mata follows her intuition to connect the local mission back to Africa, eventually going rogue and operating outside official channels in a desperate race against time.

Driven by guilt and distrust of her superiors, she goes rogue in a high-stakes race against time to uncover the truth.
